info.name: SasaPay WaaS API
info.description:
SasaPay Wallet as a Service (WaaS) API collection covering Authentication, Personal Onboarding, Business Onboarding, Customers, Payments and Transfers.

How to use:
1. Select the `SasaPay - Sandbox` or `SasaPay - Production` environment.
2. Fill in `client_id` and `client_secret` in that environment.
3. Run the request in the `Authentication` folder called `Get Access Token`. Its test script automatically saves `waas_access_token` and `waas_token_expiry` into the active environment.
4. All other requests use `Bearer {{waas_access_token}}` automatically via the collection-level Authorization setting.

Note: this collection shares its environment with the SasaPay Merchant API collection. WaaS-specific variables are prefixed `waas_` (e.g. `waas_base_url`, `waas_access_token`) to avoid clashing with the Merchant API's `merchant_` prefixed variables.

console.error('Could not parse auth response as JSON', e);
console.log('Access token saved to environment. Expires in ' + expiresIn + ' seconds.');
pm.test('access_token was saved to environment', function () {
console.error('No access_token found in response body:', pm.response.text());
pm.expect.fail('No access_token in response - check client_id/client_secret in the environment');

request.description:
Exchange your Client ID and Client Secret for a Bearer access token using the OAuth2 `client_credentials` grant.

**Auth:** Basic Auth over HTTPS — base64(client_id:client_secret). Configured in this request's Authorization tab using `{{client_id}}` / `{{client_secret}}`.

**Query params**
| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| grant_type | Yes | Must be `client_credentials` |

**Response**
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| status | true/false outcome |
| responseCode | "0" = success |
| access_token | Bearer token to use on all other WaaS requests |
| expires_in | Token lifetime in seconds (typically 3600) |
| token_type | "Bearer" |
| scope | Services this app is subscribed to |

The Tests script on this request automatically saves `waas_access_token`, `waas_token_type`, and `waas_token_expiry` into the active environment.

Step 1 of 3 in onboarding an individual beneficiary. Sends a confirmation OTP to the beneficiary's mobile number and returns a `requestId` used in the next step.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant Paybill/Till number |
| firstName | String | Yes | As on ID/passport |
| middleName | String | No | As on ID/passport |
| lastName | String | Yes | As on ID/passport |
| countryCode | String | Yes | Country calling code, e.g. "254" |
| mobileNumber | String | Yes | Beneficiary's mobile number |
| documentType | String | Yes | "1" = ID card, "2" = Passport, "3" = Alien ID |
| documentNumber | String | Yes | Number on the chosen document |
| email | String | Yes | Beneficiary's email |
| callbackUrl | String | Yes | Where onboarding status updates are POSTed |

**Response**
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| status / responseCode | Outcome of the request |
| message | e.g. "Confirmation code has been sent to 254*****573" |
| requestId | Save this — required for the Confirmation step |

Step 2 of 3. Confirms the OTP sent in step 1 and finalizes the account.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| otp | String | Yes | OTP the beneficiary received by SMS |
| requestId | String | Yes | From the Initial Onboarding response |

**Response `data`**
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| accountNumber | Beneficiary's new wallet account number |
| displayName | Beneficiary's name |
| accountStatus | See table below |
| accountBalance | Wallet balance (starts at 0) |

**accountStatus options**
| Status | Meaning | Next step |
|---|---|---|
| ACTIVE | Verified, ready to use | None |
| AWAITING_APPROVAL | KYC submitted, pending review | Wait for verification |
| AWAITING_KYC_UPLOAD | Needs KYC docs | Call Personal KYC Upload |

Step 3 of 3 — only required if accountStatus from the Confirmation step was `AWAITING_KYC_UPLOAD`.

**Payload (multipart/form-data)**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | Text | Yes | Your merchant code |
| customerMobileNumber | Text | Yes | Beneficiary's mobile number |
| passportSizePhoto | File | Yes | Current selfie/passport-style photo |
| documentImageFront | File | Yes | Front of ID/passport |
| documentImageBack | File | Yes | Back of ID/passport |

**Response**
| Field | Description |
|---|---|
| status / responseCode | Outcome |
| message | e.g. "Documents uploaded successfully." |

Note: the onboarding `callbackUrl` you supplied in step 1 will later receive an `accountStatus` of APPROVED or REJECTED once your KYC has been reviewed.

Step 1 of 3 for onboarding a business/entity beneficiary. Sends a confirmation OTP to the business's registered mobile number.

**Key payload fields**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| businessName | String | Yes | Legal/trading name |
| billNumber | Numeric | No | Business's own Paybill/Till, if any |
| description | String | Yes | Short description |
| productType | Numeric | Yes | See Reference Data → Account Product Types |
| countryId | Numeric | Yes | See Reference Data → Countries |
| subregionId | Numeric | Yes | See Reference Data → Country Sub Regions |
| industryId | Numeric | Yes | See Reference Data → Industries |
| subIndustryId | Numeric | Yes | See Reference Data → Sub Industries |
| bankId / bankAccountNumber | Numeric/String | No | See Reference Data → Channel Codes |
| mobileNumber | Numeric | Yes | Business's registered mobile |
| businessTypeId | String | Yes | See Reference Data → Business Types |
| email | String | Yes | Business email |
| registrationNumber | String | Yes | Business registration number |
| kraPin | String | Yes | KRA PIN |
| referralCode | String | No | Onboarding agent alias |
| dealerNumber | String | No | Attaches the business to a dealer |
| purpose | String | Yes | "Collection", "Disbursement", or "Remittance" |
| natureOfBusiness | String | Yes | e.g. "Retail Shop" |
| physicalAddress | String | Yes | Physical location |
| estimatedMonthlyTransactionAmount | String | Yes | Expected monthly volume (KES) |
| estimatedMonthlyTransactionCount | String | Yes | Expected monthly transaction count |
| callbackUrl | URL | Yes | Onboarding status updates |
| directors | Array | Yes | List of director objects (see below) |

**Each `directors[]` entry**
`directorName`, `directorIdnumber`, `directorMobileNumber`, `directorKraPin`, `directorDocumentType` (options: `ID_NUMBER`, `PASSPORT`, `ALIEN_ID`), `directorCountryCode`.

**Response**
Same shape as Personal Onboarding: `status`, `responseCode`, `message`, `requestId` — save `requestId` for the Confirmation step.

Step 2 of 3. Confirms the OTP sent to the business's mobile number.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| otp | String | Yes | 4-digit OTP |
| requestId | String | Yes | From the Initial request |

**Response `data`**
`requestId`, `merchantCode`, `accountNumber`, `displayName`, `accountStatus` (`ACTIVE` / `AWAITING_APPROVAL` / `AWAITING_KYC_UPLOAD`), `accountBalance`.

Step 3 of 3 — required if accountStatus is `AWAITING_KYC_UPLOAD`.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| requestId | String | Yes | From onboarding |
| businessKraPin | Image | Yes | Photo of business KRA PIN certificate |
| businessRegistrationCertificate | Image | Yes | Registration certificate |
| boardResolution | Image | Yes | Board resolution document |
| cr12Document | Image | Yes | CR12 certificate |
| proofOfAddressDocument | Image | Yes | Proof of address |
| proofOfBankDocument | Image | Yes | Proof of bank account |
| directorsKyc | Array | Yes | Per-director objects (see below) |

**Each `directorsKyc[]` entry**
`directorKraPinNumber`, `directorIdCardFront`, `directorIdCardBack`, `directorKraPin`.

Note: the top-level `directorIdCardFront`/`directorIdCardBack`/`directorKraPin` fields shown in the body are deprecated in favor of the `directorsKyc` array.

**Response:** `status`, `responseCode`, `message` (e.g. "Business KYC uploaded.")

Lists all your beneficiaries/customers.

**Query params**
| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| merchant_code | Yes | Your merchant code |

**Response**
Paginated (`links.next`/`links.previous`, `count`, `pages`). `results.customers[]` each has `client.display_name`, `account_number`, `currency_code`, `account_balance_derived`, `account_type`.

Retrieve one beneficiary's profile and wallet(s) by account number.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| accountNumber | String | Yes | Beneficiary's account number |
| countryCode | String | Yes | e.g. "254" |

**Response `data`**
`profile` (`display_name`, `mobile_number`, `account_status`), `CustomerWallets[]` (`account_number`, `currency_code`, `account_balance_derived`), `merchantCode`.

Amend a beneficiary's KYC details — typically used after a rejection during verification, so they can resubmit corrected info.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| accountNumber | String | Yes | Beneficiary's account number (from onboarding) |
| firstName / lastName | String | Yes | As on ID |
| middleName | String | No | As on ID |
| email | String | No | Updated email |
| documentType | String | Yes | "1" ID card, "2" Passport, "3" Alien ID |
| documentNumber | String | Yes | Updated document number |
| callbackUrl | URL | Yes | Where the re-verification result is sent |

**Response:** `status`, `responseCode`, `message` (e.g. prompts to re-upload KYC).

Request a payment from a beneficiary or another mobile money provider (pull payment). Behavior depends on `networkCode`.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantReference | String | Yes | Your unique transaction identifier |
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| networkCode | String | Yes | "0" SasaPay, "63902" M-PESA, "63903" Airtel Money, "63907" T-Kash |
| mobileNumber | String | Yes | Payer's mobile number |
| receiverAccountNumber | String | Yes | Wallet account to be credited |
| amount | String | Yes | Amount to collect |
| transactionFee | String | Yes | Fee charged for the top-up |
| commissionAccountNumber | String | No | Dealer/referrer account for commission |
| commissionAmount | String | No | Commission amount |
| currencyCode | String | Yes | e.g. "KES" |
| transactionDesc | String | Yes | Description |
| callbackUrl | String | Yes | Final result delivery URL |

**Response**
`checkoutRequestID` (save this — needed for Process Payment when `networkCode` is "0"/SasaPay), `merchantReference`, `customerMessage` (manual USSD instructions), `paymentGateway`.

Completes a Request Payment transaction using the verification code the payer received by SMS. Required for the SasaPay wallet channel.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| receiverAccountNumber | String | Yes | Wallet account being credited |
| checkoutRequestId | String | Yes | From the Request Payment response |
| verificationCode | String | Yes | 6-digit code sent to the payer |

**Response:** `status`, `responseCode`, `message` (e.g. "Transaction is being processed"). Final result arrives at the `callbackUrl` from the original request.

Pay a Paybill or Till number provided by SasaPay or M-PESA.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| transactionReference | String | Yes | Your unique transaction id |
| currencyCode | String | Yes | e.g. "KES" |
| amount | String | Yes | Amount to pay |
| senderAccountNumber | String | Yes | Account paying the bill |
| receiverMerchantCode | String | Yes | Paybill/Till being paid |
| accountReference | String | Yes | Account reference at the receiving business |
| chargeAccount | String | Yes | Account charged transaction fees |
| transactionFee | String | Yes | Fee amount |
| billerType | String | Yes | "PAYBILL" or "TILL" |
| networkCode | String | Yes | "0" SasaPay, "63902" M-PESA |
| callbackUrl | String | Yes | Final result URL |
| reason | String | No | Description |

**Response**
`checkoutRequestId`, `merchantReference`, `transactionCharges`, `merchantFees`.

Transfer funds from your merchant account directly to a customer's wallet or another mobile money provider.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | Numeric | Yes | Your merchant code |
| transactionReference | Alpha-Numeric | Yes | Your unique transaction id |
| currencyCode | Numeric | Yes | e.g. "KES" |
| TransactionDesc | String | Yes | Description |
| amount | Numeric | Yes | Amount to send |
| reason | String | No | Purpose of transaction |
| channel | String | Yes | See Reference Data → Channel Codes (mobile money/bank destination) |
| receiverNumber | String | Yes | Recipient's phone/account number |
| callbackUrl | URL | Yes | Final result URL |

**Response**
`checkoutRequestId`, `merchantReference`, `transactionCharges`.

Transfer funds from a beneficiary's own wallet to another mobile money provider (M-PESA, Airtel Money, T-Kash).

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| transactionReference | String | Yes | Your unique transaction id |
| currencyCode | String | Yes | e.g. "KES" |
| TransactionDesc | String | Yes | Description |
| senderNumber | String | Yes | Beneficiary's wallet account number |
| amount | String | Yes | Amount to send |
| reason | String | No | Purpose of transaction |
| chargeAccount | String | Yes | Account charged the transaction fee (merchant or beneficiary) |
| transactionFee | String | Yes | Fee amount |
| channel | String | Yes | See Reference Data → Channel Codes |
| receiverNumber | String | Yes | Recipient's phone/account number |
| callbackUrl | String | Yes | Final result URL |

**Response**
`checkoutRequestId`, `merchantReference`, `transactionCharges`, `merchantFees`.

Create a secondary wallet for an existing customer. A customer may have at most 2 wallets total (main + one sub-wallet).

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| accountNumber | String | Yes | Customer's main account number |
| mobileNumber | String | Yes | Customer's mobile number |
| subwalletType | String | Yes | "Personal" or "Business" |
| walletName | String | Yes | Display name, e.g. "Shop Wallet" |
| purpose | String | Yes | e.g. "Collection" |
| physicalAddress | String | Yes | Merchant's physical address |
| natureOfBusiness | String | Yes | e.g. "Retail shop" |
| estimatedMonthlyTransactionAmount | String | Yes | Expected monthly volume |
| estimatedMonthlyTransactionCount | String | Yes | Expected monthly count |

**Response `data`**
`accountNumber` (new sub-wallet number), `displayName`, `accountStatus`, `accountBalance`.

Fetch a paginated statement of transactions for a merchant/account.

⚠️ Per SasaPay docs, this endpoint is **Production only** — it will not work against Sandbox.

**Query params**
| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | Yes | Your merchant code |
| accountNumber | Yes | Account to fetch transactions for |

**Response**
Paginated (`count`, `current_page`, `pages`, `links`). `data.transactions[]` each has `transaction_amount`, `transaction_charges`, `transaction_type` ("TRANSACTION IN"/"TRANSACTION OUT"), `transaction_code`, `transaction_reference`, `transaction_date`, `payment_details` (`channel_name`, `party_B_account_number`), `result_code`, `result_description`, `reversal_status`.

Check the outcome of a transaction. The result is returned directly (synchronously) in this WaaS version.

**Payload** — `merchantCode` is mandatory; supply **at least one** of the other three fields.
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | Number | Yes | Your merchant code |
| checkoutRequestId | Alpha-Numeric | One of these 3 | From the original payment request |
| merchantTransactionReference | Alpha-Numeric | One of these 3 | Your original transaction reference |
| transactionCode | Alpha-Numeric | One of these 3 | SasaPay's transaction code |

**Response `data`**
`TransactionType` (e.g. B2C, C2B), `TransactionDate`, `TransactionAmount`, `Paid`, `AmountPaid`, `PaidDate`, `SourceChannel`, `DestinationChannel`, `TransactionCode`.

Check the merchant's account balances across account labels.

**Query params**
| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | Yes | Your merchant code |

**Response `data`**
`CurrencyCode`, `OrgAccountBalance`, `Accounts[]` — each `{account_label, account_balance}` for labels like Bulk Payment, Utility Account, Working Account, Wallet as Service.

Pay for airtime or a bill on behalf of a customer.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| transactionReference | String | Yes | Your unique transaction id |
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| serviceCode | String | Yes | See options below |
| payerAccountNumber | String | Yes | Account paying for the utility |
| accountNumber | String | Yes | Account being paid for (a phone number when purchasing airtime) |
| currencyCode | String | Yes | e.g. "KES" |
| amount | String | Yes | Amount to pay |
| transactionFee | String | Yes | Fee amount |
| callbackUrl | String | Yes | Final result URL |

**serviceCode options:** `AIRTIME`, `SP-SAFARICOM`, `SP-AIRTEL`, `SP-TELKOM` (plus other bill-payment billers configured on your account, e.g. water/electricity)

**Response**
`checkoutRequestId`, `merchantReference`.

Look up a bill's amount due before paying it.

**Payload**
| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| merchantCode | String | Yes | Your merchant code |
| serviceCode | String | Yes | e.g. "SP-NRB-WATER" |
| customerMobile | String | Yes | Mobile number linked to the bill account |
| accountNumber | String | Yes | Bill account number |

**Response `data`**
`accountNumber`, `serviceCode`, `dueDate`, `dueAmount`, `currency`, `customerName`. Fields may be blank if not available for that biller.

Returns the list of banks and their channel codes — used as the `channel` value in Merchant Transfers / Send Money.

**Response**
`data[]` — each `{bank_name, bank_code}`.

Returns active countries supported for onboarding.

**Response**
`data[]` — each `{id, name, calling_code, country_code}`. Use `id` as `countryId` when onboarding a business.

Returns sub-regions for a given country.

**Query params**
| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| callingCode | Yes | Country calling code, e.g. "254" |

**Response**
`data[]` — each `{id, name}`. Use `id` as `subregionId` when onboarding a business.

Returns the list of industries.

**Response**
`data[]` — each `{id, code_value}`. Use `id` as `industryId` when onboarding a business.

Returns sub-industries for a given industry.

**Query params**
| Field | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| industryId | Yes | From the Industries endpoint |

**Response**
`data[]` — each `{id, sub_industry}`. Use `id` as `subIndustryId` when onboarding a business.

Returns business legal-structure types.

**Response**
`data[]` — each `{id, name}` (e.g. "Sole Proprietor", "Private Limited Liability Companies"). Use `id` as `businessTypeId` when onboarding a business.

Returns account/product types.

**Response**
`data[]` — each `{id, name, description, currency_code}` (e.g. "Till-BusinessOption", "PayBill-CustomerOption"). Use `id` as `productType` when onboarding a business.
